svg.aria-label: One deal accumulating history across six weekly runs, drawn as 8-bit pixel art. Discovery covers weeks 1 and 2, earning a discovery call and an intro email in week 1. Evaluation covers weeks 3 and 4, earning a demo call and a Slack thread in week 3 and an AE note in week 4. Proposal is week 5, earning a proposal email. Closed-Won is week 6, earning a win-loss interview and a hash win-loss post.
